{{Quote|It's Hova Mensk and the Blurtones; they're playing tonight in the Starbirth Lounge on Deck 56.|Ssorku|<ref name="Horning In">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20020117a_horningin&c=rpg|text=Horning In|int=Horning In}}</ref>}}
The '''Starbirth Lounge''' was a lounge room that was situated on Deck 56 of the [[Nessem Shipyards]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that was located near to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nessem]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]] band [[Hova Mensk and the Blurtones]] played at a concert that was held in the Starbirth Lounge. The event was attended by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Ssorku]] and while he watched the band, he was confronted by a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents that sought to obtain a set of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Quadronomic Fluxer|component]] schematics that Ssorku had stolen.
